# TROT Solutions

TROT Solutions provides engineering products, specialized lifting equipment, and comprehensive lifecycle services for ports and logistics sectors worldwide. 

## Key Services
- Brokerage & Resale of Port Equipment
- Engineering Products (Bromma Spreaders, Dutch Lanka Trailers)
- Preventive & Predictive Maintenance
- Health Assessment & Diagnostics
- Modernization & Upgrades
- Structural Life Extension
- Scrap Management & Recycling

## Mission
To supply the global ports and logistics industries with top-tier equipment and expert technical consulting.
